meta.postDescription: List your apartment, house, room or hotel in Georgia in a few simple steps.

start.title: Post a listing
start.subtitle: List your home, room or hotel in a few simple steps. Everything is saved as you go, so you can stop and come back any time.
start.newDescription: It takes about 10 minutes. You can stop at any time and continue later.

how.photos: At least {count} photos of the place
how.address: The address — only an approximate area is shown publicly
how.price: Your price and the dates it's available

start.trust: Every listing is checked before it goes live. Your first listing is reviewed by a person — usually within a day.

shabbat.no_motion_sensors: No motion-sensor lights or automatic doors

deal.title: What would you like to list?
deal.subtitle: Choose the kind of deal. You can change it later.

descriptions.SHORT_STAY: Guests stay a few nights or weeks — priced per night.
descriptions.MONTHLY_RENT: Tenants rent for a month or longer — priced per month.
descriptions.SALE: Sell an apartment, house or villa — one total price.
descriptions.HOTEL_ROOM: A hotel, guesthouse or hostel with one or more room types.

deal.editNote: Changing the deal type may hide some details that don't fit the new type.

property.title: What kind of place is it?
property.subtitle: Pick the type that describes it best.

descriptions.APARTMENT: A flat in a residential building.
descriptions.STUDIO: One open room with a kitchen corner.
descriptions.PENTHOUSE: A top-floor apartment, often with a terrace.
descriptions.VILLA: A large house, usually with a garden or pool.
descriptions.COTTAGE: A small house in nature — mountains, sea or village.
descriptions.ROOM: A private room in an apartment shared with others.
descriptions.HOTEL: A hotel with several rooms and reception.
descriptions.HOSTEL: Beds or rooms in a hostel.

business.title: Hotels, guesthouses and hostels are business listings
business.description: Your account will get the "Business" label, so guests can tell private owners and businesses apart. Add your business name below.
business.descriptionExisting: Your account is a business account. Guests will see your business name.
business.nameHelp: Shown to guests on your listings and profile.

location.title: Where is it?
location.subtitle: Choose the city, find the address and put the pin exactly on the building.
location.neighborhoodHelp: We pick the nearest one from the pin — change it if needed.
location.noCities: No cities are available yet. Please try again later.
location.searchHelp: Type the address and press Search. Results come from OpenStreetMap.
location.searchError: The address search isn't answering right now. You can still tap the map to put the pin.
location.searchEmpty: No addresses found. Try another spelling or tap the map.
location.searchCount: {count, plural, =0 {No addresses found} one {1 address found} other {{count} addresses found}}
location.addressHelp: Street, number, entrance and apartment. Only you see it — you share it after a guest contacts you.
location.mapHelp: Tap the map to put the pin, then drag it to the exact spot.
location.mapLabel: Map for choosing the exact location
location.pinLabel: Location pin (drag to move, or use the arrow keys)
location.geoUnsupported: Your browser can't share your location. Please search the address or tap the map.
location.geoOutside: Your location seems to be outside Georgia. Please search the address or tap the map.
location.tapOutside: That spot is outside Georgia. Tap a place inside Georgia.
location.geoDenied: Location access was blocked. You can allow it in your browser settings, or tap the map.
location.geoFailed: We couldn't find your location. Please search the address or tap the map.
location.privacyNote: Only the approximate area (about {meters} m) is shown publicly. You share the exact address after a guest contacts you.
location.searchShort: Type at least 3 letters, then press Search.
location.searchBusy: Lots of searches right now. Try again in a few seconds, or tap the map.
location.addressFromSearch: We filled in the street and house number. Add the entrance and apartment — only you see this address.

details.roomsHelp: All rooms except the kitchen and bathrooms (2.5 is fine).

buildingAgeHelp.NEW: Built in recent years (often with a new-building frame status).
buildingAgeHelp.OLD: An older building, for example Soviet-era or historic.

details.marketDescription: Georgian property terms help buyers and tenants compare places.

conditionHelp.BLACK_FRAME: Bare shell: walls and roof only, no plaster, wiring or plumbing.
conditionHelp.WHITE_FRAME: Ready for finishing: plastered walls, wiring and plumbing in place.
conditionHelp.GREEN_FRAME: Almost finished: floors, doors and bathroom done, only final touches left.
conditionHelp.NEWLY_RENOVATED: Fully renovated recently and ready to move in.
conditionHelp.OLD_RENOVATION: Renovated years ago — livable, but showing its age.
conditionHelp.NEEDS_RENOVATION: Needs repairs before living there comfortably.

details.cadastralHelp: Used only to verify that you own the property. It is never shown.
details.sharedTitle: Who is the shared room for?
details.sharedDescription: For rooms in shared apartments only: let guests know who shares the apartment.
details.writingInHelp: The language of your title and description.
details.titleHelp: Short and clear, for example "Sunny 2-room apartment near Vake Park".
details.titleEmojiRemoved: We removed the emoji from the title. They're fine in the description.
details.descriptionHelp: What makes it special, the neighborhood, how to get there. Don't add phone numbers or links — guests contact you with the buttons.
details.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the rooms, the view, what's nearby and who the place is perfect for.
details.tourUrlHelp: A virtual tour link on Matterport, Kuula, Momento360 or Roundme, starting with https://.

size.title: Size and rooms
size.subtitle: How many rooms and beds there are, and how big the place is.

building.title: The building
building.subtitle: Floor, elevator and year built. Skip anything you don't know.

features.title: Condition and features
features.subtitle: Everything here is optional. Open only what matters for your place.

text.title: Title and description
text.subtitle: Write in your own language — we can translate it into the other languages.

amenities.title: What does the place offer?
amenities.subtitle: Tick everything guests can use.
amenities.legendHelp: Only tick what is really there — guests filter by these.
amenities.rulesDescription: Leave a question unanswered if it doesn't matter to you.

jewish.title: Jewish-friendly details
jewish.subtitle: Fill in only what the place has. Guests who keep kosher or Shabbat filter by these details.

kitchenHelp.CAN_KASHER: Guests may kasher the kitchen, or you prepare it on request.
kitchenHelp.KOSHER: A kosher kitchen with separate dishes for meat and dairy.

jewish.shabbatDescription: Tick what the place has. Guests who keep Shabbat check these first.

shabbatHelp.hot_plate: An electric warming plate for keeping food hot on Shabbat.
shabbatHelp.hot_water_urn: A hot-water urn (kettle that stays on) for tea and coffee.
shabbatHelp.light_timers: Lights can be set on a timer (Shabbat clock).
shabbatHelp.mechanical_key: The door opens with a regular metal key, not a code or card.
shabbatHelp.stairs_or_shabbat_elevator: Guests can reach the apartment by stairs, or there's a Shabbat elevator.
shabbatHelp.no_motion_sensors: No motion-sensor lights or automatic doors at the entrance — or they can be switched off.

jewish.badgeOn: Your listing will show the "Shabbat-friendly" badge.
jewish.badgeOff: To get the badge, the place needs all of these:
jewish.ruleSensors: No motion sensors or automatic doors
jewish.ruleHeat: A hot plate or a hot-water urn

jewishHelp.sukkah_space: A balcony or yard open to the sky.
jewishHelp.pesach_ready: The kitchen can be prepared for Pesach.
jewishHelp.separable_beds: Double beds that can be pulled apart.

jewish.walkingNote: Walking time to the nearest synagogue and Chabad house is calculated automatically from your pin on the map.
jewish.bigFamilyNote: Places that sleep {count} or more get the "Suits big families" label automatically.
jewish.bigFamilyOn: Your listing will get the "Suits big families" label.
jewish.hotelDescription: For hotels and guesthouses: meals and kosher supervision.
jewish.certNameHelp: The name of the rabbinate or organization that gives the certificate.
jewish.certHelp: A photo or PDF. It is kept private and checked by our team.
jewish.fairHousing: These details help guests find a good fit. They never limit who may stay — every listing is open to everyone.

photos.title: Add photos
photos.subtitle: Bright, real photos get many more messages. Add at least 5.
photos.privacyNote: Location data (GPS) is removed from your photos and a light watermark with our logo is added, so they can't be copied to fake listings.
photos.count: {count, plural, =0 {No photos yet} one {1 photo} other {{formatted} photos}} · up to {max}
photos.needMore: {count, plural, one {Add 1 more photo} other {Add {formatted} more photos}}

rejected.notImage: Some files were skipped because they aren't photos.
rejected.tooBig: Some photos were skipped because they are too large (over 40 MB).
rejected.tooMany: {count, plural, =0 {You've reached the photo limit.} one {Only 1 more photo fits — the rest were skipped.} other {Only {count} more photos fit — the rest were skipped.}}

photos.dropHelp: or choose them from your phone or computer. Several at once is fine.
photos.remaining: {count, plural, one {You can add 1 more photo} other {You can add {formatted} more photos}}
photos.gridHelp: Drag to change the order. The first photo is the cover — tap the star to make another photo the cover.
photos.emptyDescription: Add at least {count} photos: the living room, bedrooms, kitchen, bathroom and the view.

tips.light: Shoot in daylight with the curtains open and the lights on.
tips.horizontal: Hold the phone horizontally and stand in a corner of the room.
tips.rooms: Show every room, the bathroom, the kitchen and the view.
tips.real: Use your own, real photos — copied photos are detected and blocked.

photos.watermarkNote: Photos are compressed in your browser before upload, so it's quick even on mobile data.
photos.altPlaceholder: e.g. Living room with a balcony
photos.altHelp: Optional. Helps blind and low-vision guests.
photos.deleteDescription: The photo will be removed from your listing. This can't be undone.
photos.dndInstructions: To move a photo, press Space or Enter, use the arrow keys to move it, then press Space or Enter again. Press Escape to cancel.
photos.roomHelp: Pick what each photo shows. On the listing page the photos are grouped by room, so guests quickly find the kitchen, the bedrooms and the bathroom.

rooms.title: Room types
rooms.subtitle: Add each kind of room you offer, with its own price and photos.
rooms.name: Room name
rooms.nameHelp: For example "Double room with balcony" or "Family suite".
rooms.quantity: How many of these rooms to offer on Bayit
rooms.quantityHelp: You may offer fewer rooms than you have, to lower the risk of a double booking with other sites.
rooms.emptyDescription: Add the rooms you offer — guests compare them by price, beds and photos.
rooms.deleteDescription: The room type and its photos will be removed. This can't be undone.
rooms.namesNote: Room names are shown in your language until they are translated.
rooms.weekendPriceHelp: For Friday and Saturday nights. Leave it empty to use the regular price. Holiday prices are set in the calendar.
rooms.amenitiesHelp: On top of what the whole place has.
rooms.activeOff: Off: guests don't see it. Bookings already made are kept.
rooms.hasBookings: This room has upcoming bookings, so it can't be deleted. You can switch it off instead.

price.title: Price and availability
price.subtitle: Set your price in the currency you prefer — guests can see it in theirs.
price.priceFromHelp: Optional: the lowest price guests pay. If you leave it empty, we show "from" your cheapest room type.
price.perSqmHelp: Add the size in the Details step to show the price per m².
price.priceHistoryNote: If you lower the price, your listing shows a "Price dropped" label for a while.
price.depositHelp: Refunded at the end of the stay.
price.utilitiesIncluded: Utilities are included in the price
price.utilitiesEstimateHelp: Electricity, gas, water and internet — a rough monthly amount.
price.calendarDescription: Mark the dates when the place is not available. All other dates show as free.
price.calendarHelp: Choose the first and the last day, then mark them as unavailable.
price.calendarSaveFailed: The calendar wasn't saved. Please try again.
price.icalDescription: Avoid double bookings: connect your calendars both ways.
price.icalExportHelp: Paste this link into Airbnb or Booking.com ("Import calendar") so dates blocked here are blocked there too.
price.icalImportHelp: Paste up to 3 .ics links from Airbnb or Booking.com. Their bookings show here as unavailable, updated every few hours.
price.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Please select the link and copy it.

booking.title: Bookings and price
booking.subtitle: Price per night, stay rules and cancellation policy. Guests book on the site and pay you on arrival.
booking.instantBody: When the dates are free, the booking is confirmed right away, with no need to approve each guest. You set rules (minimum nights, number of guests, times), not who comes.
booking.hotelPriceHelp: Each room type has its own price. If you leave this empty, we show "from" the cheapest room.
booking.currencyHelp: Guests pay you in this currency.
booking.legacyWeekly: Your earlier price was per week (<price></price>). Bookings on the site are priced per night, so please enter a nightly price.
booking.weekendPriceHelp: For Friday and Saturday nights. If empty, the regular price applies.
booking.priceHistoryNote: If you lower the price, the listing shows a "Price dropped" label for a while.
booking.feesDescription: Optional. Guests see every amount before they book.
booking.depositHelp: Paid on arrival and returned at the end of the stay. Not part of the booking total.
booking.stayDescription: The rules apply to every guest equally.
booking.maxGuestsHelp: Adults and children. Infants under 2 don't count.
booking.maxGuestsHotelHelp: Optional: each room type can have its own number.
booking.timesHelp: Check-in: the earliest time guests can arrive. Check-out: the latest time they leave. Without a check-in time, or with “Flexible”, the free-cancellation deadline is counted from {time}.
booking.policyDescription: Choose one of three options. Guests see it before they book.
booking.policyNote: Guests pay only on arrival, so nobody is charged for cancelling. A cancellation after the deadline is recorded as late.
booking.paymentLegend: How can guests pay you on arrival?
booking.noFeesNote: Bayit takes no payment and no fee. Never ask guests to pay in advance through a link.
booking.calendarDescription: Block dates, see bookings and connect your Airbnb and Booking.com calendars to avoid double bookings.
booking.discountsDescription: A percent off the nights (not the cleaning fee). From 28 nights the monthly discount applies instead of the weekly one. Optional.
booking.discountExample: For example: a week at your regular price costs guests <after></after> instead of <before></before>.
booking.instantHotelBody: Guests choose a room type and how many rooms, and the booking is confirmed at once when rooms are free. You set rules, not who comes.

contact.title: How should guests contact you?
contact.subtitle: Choose the apps you use and put your favorite first.
contact.methodsDescription: Guests see the buttons in this order. Your details stay hidden until a signed-in guest taps "Show contact".
contact.empty: No contact methods yet. Add at least one below.

valueHelp.TELEGRAM: Like @yourname, or a phone number with the country code.
valueHelp.MESSENGER: The part after facebook.com/ — for example john.cohen.

contact.emailHidden: Your email stays hidden — guests write to you through a contact form.
contact.privacyNote: To stop bots, contact details are only shown to signed-in guests, and every message button starts with a ready text in the guest's language.
contact.dndInstructions: To move a contact method, press Space or Enter, use the arrow keys, then press Space or Enter again. Press Escape to cancel.
contact.hoursDescription: Optional. Guests see your local time and when you usually answer.
contact.noShabbat: I don't answer on Shabbat and holidays
contact.noShabbatHelp: During Shabbat and Jewish holidays guests see "Replies after Shabbat".

pledge.title: The Bayit pledge
pledge.subtitle: One last step before the preview: a short commitment every Bayit host accepts.

reasons.guests: Israeli and Jewish guests know they are welcome at your place, and contact you with peace of mind.
reasons.everyone: Every host here makes the same promise.

publish.title: Preview and publish
publish.subtitle: Check how guests will see your listing, then publish it.

missing.location: Choose the city and put the pin on the map
missing.size: Fill in the size and rooms
missing.features: Fix the details in “Condition and features”
missing.text: Write a title and a description

publish.previewDescription: This is how your listing appears in search results and on its page.
publish.contactHidden: Your phone numbers and usernames are shown only after a signed-in guest taps "Show contact".
publish.repliesAfterShabbat: On Shabbat and holidays guests see "Replies after Shabbat".
publish.approxArea: The map shows the area around {city} within about {meters} m, not your exact address.
publish.languagesAuto: Your listing is shown in 5 languages. Translate it automatically, then check and edit each version.
publish.languagesManual: Automatic translation isn't available right now. Your listing will show in your language with a note for other visitors. You can also write your own version in any language.
publish.translateNeedsText: Write the title and description first.
publish.translated: Translations are ready. Please check them.
publish.statusAuto: Translated automatically — check it and fix anything that sounds wrong.
publish.statusMissingAuto: Not translated yet. Use "Translate into all languages" or write your own version.
publish.statusMissingManual: Visitors will see your text in {language}. You can write a version for this language yourself.
publish.expiry: Listings stay up for {days} days and can be renewed.
publish.rules: I accept the <link>listing rules</link>: the place is real, the photos are mine, and I won't ask for money before guests have checked the place.
publish.rulesRequired: Please accept the listing rules to publish.
publish.reviewNote: After you publish, our automatic checks run. Your first listing is always reviewed by a person — usually within a day.
publish.publishBlocked: {count, plural, one {1 thing is still missing before you can publish.} other {{count} things are still missing before you can publish.}}
publish.editNote: Your changes are saved as you go. Press "Save changes" when you're done so we can check them again.

result.liveBody: Guests can find it now. Share it with friends and in groups to get your first messages faster.
result.reviewBody: Your listing goes live after a person on our team checks it — usually within a day. We'll email you when it's live.
result.blockedTitle: Your listing needs a few changes
result.blockedBody: Our automatic checks found something that has to be fixed before the listing can go live.
result.savedBody: Your listing is up to date.
result.shareFailed: Couldn't share. Please copy the link from the listing page.

next.step1: A member of our team checks the photos, the price and the details.
next.step2: If something needs changing, we tell you exactly what by email.
next.step3: Once approved, your listing goes live and you get an email.

duplicate_photos_other_account.title: Some photos are already used in another listing
duplicate_photos_other_account.fix: Please use your own photos of this place. If someone copied your photos, contact support.

duplicate_photos_same_account.title: Some photos are the same as in your other listing
duplicate_photos_same_account.fix: Each listing needs its own photos. Replace the repeated photos.

price_far_below_area.title: The price is much lower than similar places
price_far_below_area.fix: Please check the price and the currency. A very low price is a common scam sign.

scam_phrase.title: The text contains words often used in scams
scam_phrase.fix: Remove requests for deposits before viewing, money transfers, gift cards or crypto.

blocked_phrase.title: The text contains words that aren't allowed
blocked_phrase.fix: Please rewrite the title or description without them.

contact_info_in_text.title: The text contains a phone number, email or link
contact_info_in_text.fix: Remove contact details from the title and description — guests contact you with the buttons.

new_account_velocity.title: Many listings from a new account
new_account_velocity.fix: No changes needed — a person will check your listings soon.

shared_device.title: Extra check for this device
shared_device.fix: No changes needed — a person will check your listing soon.

voip_phone.title: Your phone number looks like an internet number
voip_phone.fix: No changes needed — a person will check your listing. A regular mobile number helps guests trust you.

phone_not_verified.title: Your phone number isn't verified
phone_not_verified.fix: Verify your phone number in your account, then publish again.

other.title: Something needs checking
other.fix: Please review your listing. If you're not sure what to change, contact support.

result.calendarBody: Block the dates when the place isn't free, and connect your Airbnb and Booking.com calendars so you never get double bookings.

mistakes.subtitle: We checked your listing before guests see it.

mistakes.allGoodHint: We found no mistakes in your listing.
mistakes.errorsHint: {count, plural, one {One thing stops publishing.} other {{count} things stop publishing.}}

mistakes.summaryErrors: {count, plural, one {1 thing to fix} other {{count} things to fix}}
mistakes.summaryWarnings: {count, plural, one {1 thing to check} other {{count} things to check}}

issues.address_missing: The exact address is missing. Guests get it only after they book, and without it they can't find the place.
issues.photos_too_few: {count, plural, =0 {There are no photos yet} one {There is only 1 photo} other {There are only {count} photos}}. You need at least {min} to publish.
issues.contact_in_title: The title contains {kind}: {value}. Contact details are shown only through the contact buttons, to protect you and your guests from scams.
issues.contact_in_description: The description contains {kind}: {value}. Contact details are shown only through the contact buttons, to protect you and your guests from scams.
issues.contact_in_translation: The {language} version you wrote yourself contains {kind}: {value}. Contact details are shown only through the contact buttons, to protect you and your guests from scams.

issues.pin_outside_city: The pin on the map is about {km} km from the center of the city you chose. Check that the city and the pin are right.
